tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi gnas

bshad bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ 'dir dus gsum du byon pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi zhing khams kyi mchog 'og min stug po bkod pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags tshogs rgya mtsho 'du ba'i gnas chen 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i chos gzhi mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu/ ting 'dzin 'bum phrag brgya'i 'byung gnas/ legs bshad bye ba sgrog pa'i skyed tshal/ 'gro kun thar par bgrod pa'i them skas/ srid zhi'i phan bde kun gyi rtsa ba/ mchog dang thun mong 'grub pa'i zhing sa/ kun khyab 'phrin las 'bar ba'i nyid byed/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rab 'byams srid zhi mtha' dag gi rnam dkar legs tshogs thams cad 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub ngang gis 'du ba'i gnas/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang 'di'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can/ /mnyam med shākya seng ge dus 'khor lo/ /gsang bdag 'jam dpal phyag na pad+ma sogs/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogs/ /'phags yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan dus 'khor zhabs/ /bstan pa 'di la mkhas dang grub pa'i dpal/ /bgrang bar mi dpyod yang dag lam ston pa/ / kun gyi rgyan gyur 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal/ /dol po ba zhes snyan pa'i 'brug sgra yis/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo ma lus bgengs mdzad pa/ khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas kun yang khyed kyi rnam 'phrul lags/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi yab kyang khyed/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /rten dang mgon skyabs bla ma khyed gcig pu/ /drag po 'jug sel dbyig gi snying po sogs/ dregs ldan kun gyis mchod bstod bkur sti'i yul/ /rgyal ba khyed las gzhan du ma mchis te/ /'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs/

/kun gyi skyob pa gcig po'ang rgyal ba khyod/ /srid zhir gtogs pa'i skye bo thams cad la/ / mtha' dag legs lam stsal ba'ang khyod nyid lags/ /de ltar skyabs gnas rgya mtsho dkon mchog gsum/ /kun 'dus dus gsum sangs rgyas jo nang ba/ /kun gyi byed po 'dren mchog bla med des/ /srid gsum mtha' dag skyong ba'i dge legs stsol/ /de ltar na/ sgrub gnas thams cad kyi rgyal po/ ri khrod chen po dpal jo mo nang gi gnas kyi sgo chen por gyur pa 'di nyid la dang por phyi 'byung bas sgrub pa'i dge mtshan gyi dbang du byas na/ brtan cing brjid la mtho zhing lhun chags pa/ /lhun po bye ba phrag brgya'i dpal yon can/ /nags rgyal zhes bya ri'i dbang po'i 'dabs/ sa bsrung bu yi gdong gi dbyibs can yod/ /rgyab ri nor bu'i brag tshogs gtams pa ni/ /lha min g.yul 'joms lha tshogs dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos pa 'gying pa'i sku/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i rnam pa can/ /de yi mdun du rin chen char 'bab cing*/ /gter gyi bum pa 'dra ba'i rtags mtshan dang*/ /mdun nas bltas na g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung*/ /rgyab bltas bang rim dang bcas mchod rten dbyibs/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs mkha' la rnyog pa 'dra/ /de dang nye ba'i ngos la dge mtshan ni/ /dpal gyi be'u la sogs bkra shis kyi/ /rtags brgyad po rnams yongs su tshang bar yod/ /sa gzhi shar dang dbang ldan phyogs su gzhol/ /nub dang lho yi phyogs su pags kyis mtho/ /rgyud sde kun las dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa yi/ /sa gzhi'i mtshan nyid mchog tu bsngags pa yin/ /byang gi phyogs su lu hi tar grags pa/ /rig byed gzhung las tshangs pa'i sras su bshad/ /chu klung kun gyi rgyal po grags ldan 'bab/ /'bab chu gzhan yang g.yas phyogs 'khyil bas 'gro /shar phyogs ri 'di blon po rin chen 'dra/ /nyi zla gza' skar thams cad 'char ba'i gnas/

/shar lho'i phyogs na nor bu rin chen brag /rnam mang chos dang nor gter du mas gang*/ /lho phyogs grub pa'i gnas chen kun kyi gtso/ /mtha' yas dngos grub bye ba'i gter chen bzhugs/ /bden bral ngos la 'khor lo rin po che/ /lte ba brtan cing rtsibs brgyad gsal bar snang*/ /chu bdag phyogs kyi ri bo mgyogs 'gro'i gtso/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i lam dang bcas te yod/ /nub byang khyim bdag rin chen go mtshon bcas/ /snying stobs sra zhing brtan pa dpa' bo'i tshul/ /byang phyogs shes rab mtshan ldan nags kyi ri/ /btsun mo dam pa'i rnam pa mchog tu gsal/ /dbang ldan mtshams na glang chen lus rgyas pa/ /'gying zhing gus pas tshur la 'ong ba'i tshul/ /mkha' la 'khor lo bcu drug rtsibs ldan dang*/ /sa gzhi la yang pad+ma rgyas pa'i tshul/ /g.yas kyi ri bo mtho zhing skyob 'dra dang*/ /g.yon phyogs dar dkar yol ba brkyang ba bzhin/ /rgyab ri mtho zhing gzengs mtho lhun re chags/ /rgya nag rtsis kyis dpyad nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /shar gyi stag dang lho yi g.yu 'brug dang*/ /nub kyi bya dang byang gi rus sbal sogs/ /mdor na rgyal pa'i bka' dang 'jig rten gyi/ /gtsug lag rnams las ji skad bshad pa yi/ /sa gzhi'i dge mtshan ji snyed bshad pa yi/ /sa gzhi'i dge mtshan ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thams cad gnas mchog 'di la tshang bar bzhugs/ /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni sus 'dug kyang*/ /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs shas chung zhing*/ /dge ba'i chos rnams gong nas gong du 'phel/ /gnyid rmugs gsal zhing rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /zhen chags chung zhing nges 'byung 'phel ba'i gnas/ /gnod sems zhi zhing snying rje rgyas pa'i gnas/ /rnam g.yengs sangs shing zhi gnas brtan pa'i gnas/ /log lta mi 'byung lhag mthong ngang gis skye/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /phyogs 'dzin can gyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ /the rang 'gong pos grags pa bsgrags pa dang*/

/dbang sdud nor sgrub la sogs rten 'brel gyis/ /'du 'tshog byung zhing grags pa tsam zhig la/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams chu ltar rgyug bzhin du/ /zhing mchog yin par 'khrul dang 'di mi mnyam/ /gzhan du lo dang zla ba bsgoms pa pas/ /gnas mchog 'dir ni zhag dang za ma tsam/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon lhag par che ba yin/ /gzhan du yun ring dge sbyor 'bad pa bas/ /sdig pa'i las spangs chos dang bla ma la/ /mos gus byas nas gnas 'dir nyal ba yang*/ /bla med byang chub mchog la shin tu nye/ /nya pa gdol pa ri dwags dman pa dang*/ /mtshams med byas pa la sogs sdig can yang*/ /rang nyid dad pa'am gzhan gyis bskul yang rung*/ /gnas 'di bskor zhing gtsug lag khang la lta/ khrus byas phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa 'bul/ /de yi sdig pa dag nas lha yul skye/ /skye bo gzhan dag smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /gnas mchog 'di ni mthong ba don ldan yin/ /de yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer la brten nas 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'dir/ skyes bu dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon mod kyang*/ rgya bod la sogs pa 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi dum bu 'dir/ nges pa'i don gyi gnad ma lus shing lus pa med pa phyin ci ma log cing ma 'khrul ba rgya cher gsungs pas/ skal ldan gyi skye bo gzhal du med pa tshim par mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba nyid kyis rnga bo che'i mdo dang*/ u dum ba ra'i me tog ltar dkon pa'i mdo sde la sogs pa/ mdo sde du ma zhig nas lung bstan pa'i/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad du mtshan snyan pa'i 'brug sgras khyab pa/ mkhas grub kyi bstan 'dzin gza' skar bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes yon tan 'phrin las 'od stong bdag po'i tshul gyis/

gzhan thams cad zil gyis mnan te bzhugs pa de yin pa gda'/ de nyid kyi ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul las sprul pa ni/ rnga bo che'i le'u zhes bya ba/ nges don mthar thug ma sbas shing gsar bar bstan pa'i mdo sde chen po de nyid kyi/ tha ma'i tshig gis lung bstan pa/ 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir shin tu phyi mar gyur pa'i dus su yang*/ li tsa bī gzhon nu/ 'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' ba/ dge slong blo 'chang ste/ shes rab rgyal mtshan ces bya bar gyur pa de nyid/ sngar yang shin tu phyi mar gyur pa'i dus der byung nas/ nga'i bstan pa gsal bar byed do zhes 'byung ba'i gnas gang du bstan pa gsal bar 'gyur ba'i chos gzhi gtsug lag khang gi gtso bo ni/ rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba 'di nyid yin te/ don la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyi bka' las lung bstan pa lags/ de yang rnga bo che'i mdo las/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dol po sangs rgyas de nyid kyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad cing*/ lo brgyad cu'i bar du nges don gyi bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar bar gyur la/ de nas bar skabs der cung zad nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa mi gsal bar gyur pa na/ slar yang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid 'gro ba'i don du bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshul bzung ste/ sprul pa'i skus nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad tshul lung bstan pa ni/ kye ma 'jig rten kun mthong dga'/ /bstan pa dge slong gzugs gyur nas/ /ring zhig bstan pa 'byin byed cing*/ /chos kyi rnga chen brdung bar 'gyur/ /de na mya ngan yongs 'das nas/ /de 'og 'jig rten stong par 'gyur/ /chos smra de ni 'das gyur nas/ /de 'dra gzhan ni 'ga' mi 'byung*/ /de 'dra'i dge slong rnyed dka' ste/ /rim gyis snang ba nyams par 'gyur/

/'di ltar de ni lho phyogs su/ /'byung pa'i tha ma gcig yin no/ /dam pa'i chos de nub pa'i dus su slar yang chos smra ba de 'byung par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir lho phyogs su 'byung ba zhes bshad pa ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi phyed lho ma chu bo si ti'i lho phyogs su 'byon pa'i don yin la/ de yang shin tu dus kyi tha mar/ de nyid 'byon par gsungs pa ni/ bdag cag gi rje btsun dam pa 'dis/ slar yang nges don gyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa lung bstan pa yin par gda'/ de la shing mo yos kyi lo/ dbo'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig gza' tshes sbyor ba byed pa thams cad shin tu bkra shis pa la sa chog mdzad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa nam mkha' la byon pa'i ltas dang*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas mngon sum du byon nas/ gnas de bdag gir mdzad pa'i bkod pa dang*/ phyi ltas shin tu ngo mtshar ba mang po dang bcas pa byung zhing*/ de rjes kyi nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ gtsug lag khang gi rmangs dang por bting*/ nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can dang*/ me tog gi char chen po snyon med du mthong*/ de snga sa phyogs 'di kun na grog mo la sogs pa srog chags mang yang*/ de phyin chad nas srog chags ches dkon zhing*/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa rdo'i bya ba byed pa kun la yang*/ srog chags kyi rigs gtan nas med par song*/ gnas gzhi dgon sde chen po 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i dus skabs thams cad du/ las byed kyi skye bo thams cad kyang*/ gzhan gyis bskul ba la ma ltos par/ rab tu dga' zhing spro bas las la ngang gi 'jug pa dang*/ mtshan mo'i cha la skye bo thams cad nyal ba'i skabs su yang*/ sa rdo shing gsum gyi las ka byed mkhan mang po yod pa 'dra ba dang*/ phyis bris 'bur brdung gsum gyi rten bzhengs pa'i skabs su yang*/ nam gung las de dang de byed pa po mang du 'tshogs pa lta bu dang*/

sgra di ri ri yang nas yang du 'byung ba dang*/ rdo leb chen po mi mang pos 'degs dgos pa yang*/ mtshan mo phan tshun thag ring bar bskyal ba dang*/ bsnor te 'jog pa dang*/ ches cher shin tu lci ba'i khur chen po dag khye'u bu mo chung ngu res kyang theg pa dang*/ dgon pa dang nye bar lu ma bkod ma'i chu mig chen po sngar med gsar du brdol ba sogs/ mi'i 'gro ba so so skye bo'i mthong thos kyi spyod yul du yang*/ sde brgyad dregs pa can rnams dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gyis 'phrin las kyi mthun 'gyur mdzad pa'i rtags bshad kyis mi lang ba yod de ye shes 'phags pa'i spyod yul la bsam gyis ga la khyab/ gtsug lag khang gi zhal sa rnams nam dgos dgos su gter nas thon pa lta bu sa rdo shing sogs dkon pa ltar snang ba thams cad kyang 'bad med lhun grub tu byung*/ sngar gyi de kha'i 'phros la/ hor zla drug pa chu stod kyi tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par/ snga dro'i tsha ba thon pa nas/ nyi ma phyed yun la gtsug lag khang chen mo'i ka ba sum cu so drug po/ mi nyung dus dka' las med par tshugs pa dang*/ 'di'i thog gi shing thams cad kyang nyi ma gcig la khel/ de skabs dpal mgon po'i 'khor rnams de 'dra ba'i las la zhugs pa'i tshul gsal bar gzigs pa yin pa yang gda'/ gsum pa nang gi gtsug lag khang rten gsum dang bcas pa/ ji ltar bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ sa phyogs 'di nyid ri'i rtsa ba nas khri stegs yan chad/ e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i nang gi ngos yangs pa'i phyogs su spyir gnas gzhi 'di nyid dang*/ khyad par gtsug lag khang baṃ yig bde ba chen po'i tshul du bzhugs pa lags/ de la sngon 'o skol gyi ston pa'i bzhugs gnas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal la sogs pa shin tu gtso bor gyur pa thams cad dang mthun par/ dbus su gtsug lag khang chen po/

de'i mtha' la gtsug lag khang bcu drug gzhan yang ji ltar 'os par/ gtsug lag khang ches mang ba dang bcas te bzhugs pa yin pa las/ dbus kyi gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid rang la yang*/ nang tshan du lha khang ji snyed cig mchis pa las/ dri gtsang khang phyur bu/ gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi gtso bo 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ so so thar pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang*/ /shākya thub pa go taṃ lha yi lha/ /mi 'dul kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med/ / 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa'i mchog sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun po ste/ /grags ldan rnams kyi so so thar/ /'di ni rab tu rgyas par ston/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bskal pa 'di'i sngon rol bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs 'jig rten du byon/ de'i rjes kyi drug bcu pa la/ gtsug tor can byon/ de rjes bzhi bcu pa la thams cad skyob byon/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la/ mi rnams kyi tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa la/ bcom ldan 'das log par dad sel lam/ 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon/ gsum khri thub pa nas gser thub byon/ nyi khri thub pa nas 'od srung byon/ tshe lo brgya ba'i gnas skabs na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas bdun po de dag /sngon thugs bskyed pa'i gnas skabs nas bzung*/ 'gro ba'i don la mchog tu dpa' pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun zhes grags/ de yang spyir de dang 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa byon mod kyi/ bdun gyi grangs su bcad pa ni/ sa phyogs 'jig rten khams 'di'i dbang du byas/ dus kyang sangs rgyas gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i dbang du byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po 'di dag ni/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa bslab bya phra mo thams cad kyang gcig pa yin la/

gzhan dang gzhan dag ni/ gnad kyi dgongs don gcig tu zin yang bcas mtshams sna tshogs pa dag ni yul dus so so'i gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa'i khyad par las mang nyung rgyas bsdus/ yangs dog ma nges pa sna tshogs shig yod pa'i rigs su gda'/ des na 'phags pa'i yul na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnal ma yod pa'i phyogs su ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa'i srol ka shin tu dar ba yin/ phyogs 'dir yang de dar bar 'gyur ba'i mig ltas khyad par can bzhag pa'i phyir dang*/ don gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sku gzugs shin tu chung ba ma yin pa chabs gcig tu bzhugs pa der/ gnas skabs su yul phyogs thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ mthar thug mthong thos dran reg thams cad thar ba mchog gi sa bon thebs par 'gyur pa la gzhan pas kyang lhag par stobs che ba yin bar snang bas de la dgongs pa yin pa 'dug /de yang gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid kyi rten gtso thub pa'i dbang po 'di la sku rgyab mtho nyi shu rtsa gsum/ de'i g.yas phyogs su bzhugs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs/ sku'i g.yon gyi phyogs su bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug tor can/ de dag gi yang g.yas phyogs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob/ g.yon phyogs na log par dad sel te de rnams zhal shar gzigs su mdzad/ de dag gi g.yas phyogs zhal byang gzigs na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub dang*/ g.yon phyogs kyi zhal lho gzigs 'di/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung yin te/ de ltar drug po 'di rnams la rgyab mtho bcu gnyis re yod/ sku rgyu'i dbang du byas na/ sku rgyu shin tu 'thug par yod cing*/ so so'i rgyab yol tshun chad kyang*/ gser dngul zangs gsum las grub par bzhugs pas/ sku rgyur zangs khal brgyad brgya lhag pa dang*/ gser zho stong phrag bdun tsam dang*/

gzhan yang de la dpags pa'i rgyu tshogs shin tu rgya che ba dang*/ yon rdzongs dga' ston sogs chos nas bshad tshod dang mthun pa/ skye bo mang po'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po spel ba'i slad du gnang bar gda'/ nang bzhugs kyi dbang du byas na/ gtso bo'i dbu gtsug na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel 'khrul med 'phags pa'i yul nas gsar du byon pa/ rin po che dwangs ma'i kha dog thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed pa cig dang*/ bod yul gyi 'phel gdung rnam bzhir grags pa sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung yid ches can shin tu mang ba dang*/ byang chub shing gi yal ga gcig me tog lo ma mang po dang*/ mkhas grub dam pa so so'i thugs dam kyi rten dang*/ dbu skra na bza' sogs byin rlabs gzi byin rgyas pa'i nang bzhugs rnam grangs sum cu rtsa bdun tsam dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa go rim ma 'khrul ba dang*/ rgya bod kyi gnas chen kun gyi sa rdo shing sogs rten 'brel gyi rdzas du mas gtams par bzhugs/ rnam gzigs la sogs pa'i sku brnyan drug po 'di rnams la'ang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung 'khrul med bcu re dang*/ byang chub shing gi lo ma sogs byin rlabs kyi rten gtso bo nyid dang phal cher cha 'dra bar bzhugs/ rab gnas skabs dge mtshan gyi dbang du byas na/ sa pho rta'i lo khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi nas brtsams te/ tha skar gyi yar ngos tshes gsum gyi bar la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ bde mchog lū hi pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po dang*/ rdo rje 'jig byed dang*/ mi g.yo bla med dang*/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po dang*/ phag mo lha so bdun ma dang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams zhal phye nas rab gnas tshar re re mdzad par gda'/ sa mo lug lo'i chu'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i nang du yang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/

ye shes dbang phyug ma dang*/ sems 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog ste/ dkyil 'khor de gsum gyi steng nas rab gnas tshar gsum/ lo de nyid kyi chu stod zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor steng nas rab gnas rgyas pa gcig ste mdor na rab gnas tshar bcu gsum dang*/ skya ser skye bo yongs 'dus pa'i zhal gro dga' ston chen mo tshar gsum mdzad/ rab gnas kyi skabs thams cad du me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od sogs nyin re bzhin du byung zhing*/ skabs 'gar sgra dang dri bzang gis khyab pa sogs lan mang du byung*/ rab gnas thog ma'i skabs/ yungs kar bum nang du lhung ba/ myu gu skyes nas zla ba phyed tsam nas me tog shar ba dang*/ bar ba'i skabs/ 'phags yul ma ga dha'i phyogs nas sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs spyan drangs te/ rab gnas dngos gzhi dang po'i ye shes spyan 'dren nyid kyi skabs phebs pa dang*/ rab gnas gsum pa'i skabs su/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos khra 'brug bzhengs dus/ zo thang nas spyan drangs pa'i dang por sku'i rnam pa rags rim rang byon la/ bal po'i bzo bos cung zad tsam sgros gtsang bar byas pa'i thub pa'i sku brnyan bla ma sman chu kha pas spyan drangs te/ shar phyogs nas byon pa sogs phyi nang gi ltas thams cad legs/ rten 'brel thams cad bzang ba'i phyogs su 'grig pa yin par 'dug jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal 'di'i dbang du byas na/ ston pa'i rgyal tshab 'od srung chen po seng ge'i khri la 'khod pa nas lo brgya tsam na/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po bzhengs/ dus de tsam na/ lha'i bzo bos bzhengs pa'i sku gzugs 'phrul dang ldan pa mang du byung*/ 'phrul snang gi jo bo shākya mu ni la che ba dbyung ba'i gtam rgyud mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang*/ dus de skabs ka byon par gda'/

dpal byang chub chen po bzhugs pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad na/ gan dho la brgyad yod/ de dag re re na lha khang re re/ mdzad pa brgyad kyi nang nas mdzad pa re re'i sku brnyan bzhugs/ de thams cad lha'i bzos bos bzhengs pa yin par gda'/ jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal 'di ni de'i nang nas/ glang po che nor skyong btul ba de yin/ lha sa 'phrul snang gi byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ra mo che na bzhugs pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal 'di gsum zhal bzhin sogs bzo bkod dbyibs khyad par med pa lta bur bzhugs/ 'di yang dang por chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dam gyi rten mdzad cing pho brang du bzhugs pa yin/ de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la/ bsam yas kyi phyogs su phebs/ bad rngam pa'i lha khang du bzhugs pa las/ dus phyis chus gnod pa chen po byung ba'i skabs shig bad rngam pa dang hwa shang lha khang sogs mang po zhig la chu skyon byung*/ sku 'di re zhig ma rnyed/ klus spyan drangs pa yin nam zer ba yang byung ste/ phyis lo shas lon dus bsha' bud kyi non pa sogs ye med par lha khang gi shul nas rnyed/ rim pas pho brang sne'u gdong sogs rgyud nas/ lcags mo bya'i lo la gtsug lag khang chen po 'dir phebs pa lags/ de rjes khri rgyab la sogs pa rje btsun nyid kyi zhal bkod mdzad nas bzhengs/ 'gro ba'i don du mnga' gsol mdzad de/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin mkha' dbyings gang bar bzhugs pa 'di lags/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal hor rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' sbyin bdag mdzad de spar rnams bzhengs pa rin po che du ma bsres pa'i mtshal gyi spar btab par 'dug /bod dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams su 'di lta bu tshar gsum las lhag pa ma byon par grags shing*/ gzhan gnyis po dus phyis kha thig tshang ba med par 'dug

'di yongs rdzogs ma tshang ba med pa/ glegs shing tshun chod rgya yul nyid du bcos pa'i tshad khang gi ri mo can cha lag thams cad kha thig tshang bar bzhugs/ de rjes logs bris kyi lha rnams dang*/ rgyab yol la bzhugs pa'i lha rnams 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes ngo sprad/ logs bris la/ dus kyi 'khor lo lha lnga/ bde mchog nag po zhabs lugs rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pa/ rdo rje shugs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ kun mkhyen chen po/ gur mgon lcam dral/ rnam thos sras/ lha chen rnams kyi sku rgyab ngos la rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub pa po'i tshul du rje btsun nyid kyi sku 'dra dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de rjes sku gzhan tsho dang zab sku sogs kyang 'tsham pa bshad/ gtsug lag khang gi khyams 'di'i logs bris kyi dbang du byas na/ nges don mdo nyi shu zhes grags pa'i gleng gzhi so so'i mdo bkod dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud gsungs tshul dang*/ gzhan yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi mdzad pa'i rnam grangs ci rigs pa dang bcas pa spel nas bkod pa yin pa 'dug ka ring gnyis ma gtogs pa'i ka ba sum cu so bzhi'i zhu'i ngos la/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khrungs rabs so bzhi slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i gzhung dang mthun par bkod/ yang mdo bkod kyi bar bar na bzhugs pa 'di rnams/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang*/ dpal ldan sham bha lar byon pa'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi sku brnyan yin lags/ de nas zhing khams bzhi bcu po re re bzhin du ngo sprad/ seng ge bubs kyi ngos la/ bstan pa'i gtso bo la 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug gsal byed chen po bzhi/ rmad byung slob dpon gnyis la sogs pa bzhugs/ dbus kyi bzhugs khri chen po 'di yang khri phal pa tsam ma yin par/ gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma khri 'di nyid kyi steng du bzhengs pa'i dbang bskur sogs 'gro don du ma mdzad pa'i shin tu byings che zhing bkra shis pa 'gran zla med pa yin/

'di na dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ legs ldan chen po lcam dral gyi mgon khang byin rlabs kyi gzi brjid dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ 'di na dpal mgon lha chen dpal 'bar gyi sku brnyan sku tshad che zhing bzo bkod rnam grangs mang bar yod kyang*/ zhag bdun khongs su legs par tshar ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas pa yin/ sgo khang chen po la/ 'di na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma chen po rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ btsun mo sras dang blon po g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkod pa dang*/ 'jig rten mtha' dag gi byed pa po'am skyong ba po phyogs skyong chen po bco lnga klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de la phyogs skyong bcu zhes bya ba kun la grags shing*/ bco lnga'i nges pa 'di ni rgyud gshin rje gshed dmar nag nas 'byung ba ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed pas gsal bar mdzad pa yin pa 'dug gseng sgo la/ 'di yang sgo khang yin pas/ chos 'dul ba nas sgo khang du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa 'bri gsung ba ltar/ lte bar nyon mongs gsum/ bar du 'gro ba rgyud lnga/ tha ma rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ 'thob bya 'gog bden/ thob byed lam/ de ston pa po sangs rgyas dang bcas pa dang*/ de dag gi mthar cho 'phrul chen po'am bdud 'dul ba gang rung 'bri bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir bdud 'dul gyi bkod pa bzhengs/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas 'byung ba'i gshin rje gshed dang*/ rtsa ba'i mgon po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ steng khang bkod pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'di na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar shin tu ngo mtshar ba/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo dang*/ 'dul ba lung dang*/ las brgya pa dang*/ rtogs brjod brgya pa sogs las bsdus pa'i bkod pa bzhugs/ zhes brjod nas lo rgyus dang bstun ci rigs ci rigs 'di dang 'di'o zhes bshad

do/ /lho phyogs ngos kyi lha khang 'di na/ legs ldan ye shes kyi mgon po lha chen dpal 'bar gyi sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ dpal lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma'i sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba du ma dang bcas pa shin tu bka' gnyan par bzhugs/ shar phyogs kyi 'di rgya gar lha khang zhes bya ba/ 'phags yul gyi rten byin rlabs che tshad bzhugs te 'di'i dkar chag logs su bya/ 'og min la 'di gtsug lag khang gi yang thog yin pas/ chos mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi 'og min lha khang du mtshan btags/ mtshan don dang mthun pa'i phyir/ 'di ni steng phyogs kyi 'og min gyi bkod par gda'/ spyir 'og min zhes bya ba gsung rab nas rnam pa du ma gsungs te/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi nang tshan gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min zhes bya ba yod de/ tha mal pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi nang tshan yin/ de'i steng na lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i gnas kyi 'og min zhes kyang bya/ gnas gtsang ma chen po zhes kyang bya/ stong gsum gcig tu sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgya 'byung ba'i sprul gzhi/ sprul pa'i sku chen po de bzhugs pa'i gnas yin/ bkod pa 'di yang de'i bkod pa yin pa 'dug gzhan yang sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing khams la yang 'og min gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhes grags pa dang*/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing mchog ces bya ba/ nam mkha' dang mnyam par khyab cing longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams yin pa cig kyang gsungs so/ /'di ni don zhags lha lnga/ 'di ni rgyung sde spyi'i lugs kyi rigs lnga yum lnga/ 'di ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ 'di rnams dus 'khor nyid nas gsungs pa'i rigs bdag rgyal ba rigs drug gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyi yum gnyis gnyis/ steng gi cha la mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdor bsdus dang bcas pa'i bkod pa lags/

'di phyogs na ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs la/ bcu gcig zhal 'khor nor bzang dang rta mgrin gnyis/ spyan ras gzigs mgrin sngon/ jo bo ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra/ jo bo bde ldan/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu/ spyan ras gzigs ha la ha la/ spyan ras gzigs 'jigs pa brgyad skyaub/ dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po rigs gnyis/ yang ha la ha la phyag bzhi pa gcig spyan ras gzigs rgyal po rol ba rnams dang*/ 'di na sgrol ma lha lnga/ 'di na kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dol po pa chen po/ 'gro lding gi slob dpon lha'i 'byung ldan/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje/ sbyin bdag gi tshul du rje btsun nyid kyi sku brnyan rnams bzhugs/ 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo 'di bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa bzo bkod legs shing*/ sku rgyan sogs bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ nang bzhugs rten byin rlabs can du ma dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin/ me pho stag lo shin tu than pa che ba'i skabs/ 'di'i rab gnas mdzad pa'i nyin mo nas brtsams zhag mang por char pa gshin la che bar babs/ than pa'i 'jigs pa las grol bas/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs mar mtshan gsol ba lags/ rjes su yang 'di la sku khrus gsol zhing mchod pa phul bas/ char dkon pa'i dus su yang char ci rigs pa 'bab pa'i byin rlabs kyi ltas mngon gyur pa bzhugs/ gdung ldebs kyi 'di dag ni zhi ba dam pa rigs brgya yin par 'dug ka ba brgyad kyi ngos 'di rnams mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad yin lags/ yang 'di na rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha khang bzhugs pa yin/ rten 'di rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sngo ljang kun khyab tu grags pa/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs yin/ sku tshugs bzang zhing*/ 'phra rgyan rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/

nang bzhugs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ 'di bzhengs pa'i lo/ bstan pa la bar du gcod pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sprin bzhin dengs pa zhig byung bas/ bdud 'dul sgrol mar mtshan gsol ba yin/ 'di ni 'chi ba blu ba'i sgrol ljang*/ sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i lugs yin/ sku rgyu'i tshogs snga ma 'di dang 'dra ba rang yin na'ang*/ rgyu tshogs 'phel ba'i tshul gyis/ snga ma las sku tshad che ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa dang*/ 'di'i rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ phyogs thams cad nas rnyed bkur longs spyod sprin stibs pa bzhin byung bas/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'am/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i sgrol mar mtshan gsol/ 'di yang bzo sgros gtsang zhing*/ gzhan kun pas zil dang*/ gzi byin che ba/ rgyan sprod sogs thams cad nas rgyu tshogs 'gangs che bar bzhugs/ 'di ni yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'di nyid kyi rtog pa nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi sku brnyan lags/ 'di yang bzo sgros gtsang zhing tshugs bzang bas/ rgyan sprod sogs sku rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ 'di'i nang bzhugs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 'khrul med bcu tsam bzhugs/ 'di da lta yin phugs lha khang la sogs pa dgos pa 'dug rgyud ris kyi dbang du byas na/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma u rgyan sgrol mar grags pa gnas kyi dbang phyug ma yin/ 'di rnams mtshan yin dang mthun par rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rigs sna tshogs pa lags/ 'di rnams sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bkod pa yin/ 'di ni dpal saṃ pu ṭa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad bsdus pa de lags/ gzhan yang lha tshogs ci rigs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ bde yangs 'di la chos bzang zhes bya zhing*/ mtha' skor 'di la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ chos rgyal rigs ldan la sogs pa'i sku brnyan gyis mdzes par byas pa 'di lags shing*/

dbus kyi bzhugs khri rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba 'di na/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan grā dar ba'i dus kyi bkod pa dang*/ slob dpon puṇ+ya ā ka ra gup+ta/ slob dpon rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta/ slob dpon a bha ya a pa ra gup+ta/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa ste rdo rje gdan pa'i mtshan can bzhi po'i sku brnyan rnams bzhugs/ mtha' skor gyi gtsug lag khang bcu drug la/ 'di ni dpal chen po he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog gi bzhugs gnas yin pa'i phyir/ dpal chen lha khang zhes bya/ de la sgo khang 'di na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rabs bdun gtsug lag gi nang du 'byon pa'i bkod pa yin/ khyams 'di'i logs bris kyi dbang du byas na/ lho'i ldebs la zhing skyong yab yum bdun cu rtsa gnyis mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas gsungs pa ltar dang*/ gtsang khang gi phyi'i g.yas kyi ngos chen la/ 'khor lo sdom pa zhal phyag 'bum pa'i bkod pa dang*/ g.yon ngos la shrī badz+ra bhai ra wa thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag lugs ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ gzhan zhal shar gzigs dang nub gzigs kyi ldebs la bzhugs pa 'di rnams dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang rdo rje phag mo'i rigs kho na yin cing*/ thams cad kyang rgyud kyi rgyal po mngon brjod bla ma'am/ a bhi dha na las gsungs pa kho na yin pa 'dug lags/ seng g.yab kyi nang du gtso mo rdo rje phag mo/ gzhan grub thob kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba bzhugs zhes so sor brda sprad/ gtsang khang 'di nyid na/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa 'di/ slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa'i bzhed dgongs dang mthun par bzhengs/ 'di ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa yin te/ 'di ni phag dkar shes rab gsal byed yin/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnams la 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma rnams byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas/

'dir yang sku brnyan lhag por bzhengs pa nyid byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgor gyur pa lags/ logs bris la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dpa' po dpa' mo drug cu/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje dang bcas pa sogs dang*/ sked ris la dur khrod chen po brgyad/ lha khang nyid kyi nang yang phyogs mdog tu bsgyur ba sogs/ gzhal med khang gi mtshan nyid tshang bar bzhugs/ 'di ni phyogs dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dbang ldan lha khang du mtshan gsol/ 'di'i bar khang gi bsrung ma ni/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu yum dang bcas pa bzhugs/ lha khang 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar/ dpal gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sku brnyan bdud dpung zil gyis gnon pa 'di lags/ logs bris la khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ thub dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga/ dpal mgon po seng zhon gtso 'khor khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud gsungs pa'i gleng gzhi'i bkod pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga la sogs pa bzhugs/ khyad par gnas 'dir byang shar dbang ldan 'byung ba'i gnod pa mtha' dag bzlog pa'i phyir du lha chen po dbang ldan drag po dbang phyug nyid/ btsun mo ri'i lha mo/ 'khor 'byung po tshogs kyi mnga' bdag bzhi dang bcas pa bzhugs/ steng gi lha khang 'di na/ dpal chen po yang dag 'khor bcas dang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu phur bu'i lha tshogs/ gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon/ rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu/ dpal mgon po ma ning la sogs pa/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs rnams bzhugs/ shar sgo bar ma'i steng gi shar phyogs sman bla'i lha khang ni/ phug gi lha khang 'di na bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po'i lder bzo rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa 'di lags shing*/ logs bris la bde bar gshegs pa brgyad/

byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa bzhugs/ mdo na phyogs skyong bcu/ gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon bcu gnyis/ rgyal chen bzhi/ mgon po bang la sogs pa bzhugs/ chos bzang rdo rje'i gdan gyi bde yangs chen po'i shar sgo/ them skas g.yas g.yon steng gsum gyi ngos la/ khro bo chen po bcu/ zad par chen po bcu/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ gza' mchog chen po bcu/ klu rgyal chen po bcu/ 'byung po chen po bcu ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i sde drug srung ma drug cu la sogs pa bar chad sel ba'i lha khyad par can rnams bzhugs/ shar lho'i lha khang 'bar 'dzin du grags pa 'di na/ bar khang 'dir srung ma ming po gsum dang sring mo bzhi/ phug gi lha khang dngos gzhi 'di na/ rten gtso bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo mgon po pus btsugs ma dang*/ las thams cad sgrub pa'i lha drang srong chen po me lha zhabs 'bring gi tshul du bzhugs/ logs bris la rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud gsungs pa'i bkod pa/ gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i bkod pa/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dug sel ma/ ri khrod ma/ 'od zer can/ mi g.yo bla med lha lnga/ rje btsun nyid kyi skyes rabs 'phreng ba la sogs pa bzhugs/ lha khang steng ma 'di na bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rdor sems la sogs pa sems dpa' bcu drug 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug /hwa shang dharma ta/ rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa mang po bzhugs/ gzhal yas khang zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ dang por sgo khang 'di na/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad ldem sku'i tshul du gtsug lag khang gi nang du 'byon pa'o/ / 'khyams 'di la rgyud sde tha dad nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mang du bzhugs pa lags/ de yang g.yas bskor du byas na dang por mngon byung mgon po/

/ gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba/ 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang*/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ gdan bzhi ye shes dbang phyug ma/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rdo rje sems dpa'/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs/ phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog dus 'khor zhal bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ mahā ma ya/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo/ kha sbyor rdor sems/ sdom pa 'byung ba/ dpal sdom pa chen po/ bde mchog lū yi lugs/ dgyes pa rdo rje thod pa can/ dgyes rdor mtshon cha can/ phyag chen thig le/ bde mchog 'jam rdor/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag dpal zla gsang thig le/ dpal nag po chen po rgyud mgon rnams bzhugs/ gzhan 'khor tshogs dang lha mgron bkod pa du ma yod cing*/ seng g.yabs kyi ngos la/ thub pa'i dbang po/ 'od srung la sogs pa bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ nyi ma gung pa dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin la/ sgo stod kyi 'di grub thob chen po zhi ba sbas pa dang*/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dang*/ rje btsun nyid do/ /dbus kyi gtsang khang chen po 'di kha che lugs kyi thog 'bubs lugs su byas/ gtsang khang gi dbus su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i blos blangs ngo mtshar gzi 'od dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i skus byin gyis rlabs shing*/ dngos su bzhengs par grags pa mchod pa'i yo byad dang bcas pa 'di lags/ logs bris la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis/ gsang ba'i mchod pa yum bzhi dang bcas pa dang*/ zhal ba phyogs mdog rtsig pa dang mthun pa'i sked ris sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i tshul du yod/ bskor khang 'di la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dang tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs bzhugs/ /gsung khang du grags pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid na/ lha khang phug na bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa phyag bzhi ma'i sku brnyan/

logs bris phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang bcas pa/ 'khyams 'di'i g.yas logs na/ yum chen mo phyag gnyis pa la 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi skor ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pas bskor ba/ shar nub kyi ngos rnams la rigs lnga'i lha tshogs mang po dang*/ byang gi ngos la rje btsun dbyangs can ma'i zhing khams/ bya rgyud las 'byung ba'i nag po chen po'i zhing khams/ 'di bi kra ma shi la'i gtor ma slob dpon kun gyi thog ma/ sku sgrub snying por grags pa des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga kun las btus pa'i nang nas 'byung ba yin/ yang ma cig nags rgyal gyi zhing khams cig 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar/ gur mgon yum can lha lnga ma rnams bzhugs/ gsung rab bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gser ma yongs rdzogs tshar gnyis/ skya pod cha tshang gcig sogs bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs tshar bzhi dang*/ thor bu pa shin tu mang ba bzhugs/ /dga' ldan byams pa'i lha khang 'di'i dbang du byas na/ gtsang khang phug na rje btsun byams pa'i 'bur dod/ logs bris la yang rgyal ba ma pham pa nyid kyi sku brnyan brgya phrag mang po dang*/ 'khyams 'di la rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan gnyis/ sgrol ma dkar mo gnyis/ gzhan nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrub thabs dang bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor nas 'byung ba ltar/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha tshogs dang*/ bka' srung mgon po lho nub pa dang*/ lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā rnams bzhugs/ theg mchog he ru ka'i lha khang 'di'i dbang du byas na/ lha khang phug gi rten gtso 'di rtsa ba'i he ru ka zhes bya ba yin/ de yang gang la ngos 'dzin na/ dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa dang*/ drag po gdan can dang*/ dur khrod na dgyes pa'i he ru ka dang*/ mnyam sbyor he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang*/ gzhan yang zla gsang thig le dang*/

dgra nag gi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo nas gsungs pa la sogs pa'i he ru ka rnams sku'i rnam 'gyur gcig par byung ba de la zer ba yin/ logs bris la he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i star cig bdag med ma'i star cig /gau ri la sogs pa 'khor gyi lha mo'i star gcig rnams bzhugs/ 'khyams la rdor sems yum can/ bde mchog lhan skyes bzhugs pa/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa yin/ sngon bal po'i bzo bo gcig gis bod yul du bod skad du brtsams nas/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa la kha 'phangs pa'i lugs de ma yin/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi rgya gar gyi slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyi bzhed pa ltar/ nor ba spangs pa dang*/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa bcas pa dang bzhugs/ grub brgya lugs rnam dag de yin/ /kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs lha khang 'di'i dbang du byas na/ rten gyi gtso bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa dmar ser/ shes bya thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter chen po 'di dang*/ rgyud ris la 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po/ 'jam dpal chos kyi 'khor lo/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ 'jam dpal seng ldan/ khro bo gshin rje gshed rnams gtso bor byas shing*/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na dkar po/ ser po/ 'jam dpal chos kyi dung gi ting nge 'dzin/ 'jam dpal rdo rje chos/ 'jam dkar dpa' bo chig sgrub rnams kyi star re re bzhugs/ nub phyogs nas zhal shar du gzigs pa'i lha khang gsum la/ dang po o rgyan mkha' spyod kyi lha khang 'di'i mchod khang phug ma na/ rten gyi gtso bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma shin tu byon mtshar zhing bzhengs pa'i skabs/ 'bad rtsol med par yud kyi grub pas don la'ang byon/ khyad par ma mchis/ srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i nus mthu khyad par can/ phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel thams cad 'di las 'grig pa lags/

gtsang khang 'di'i gyang ris la/ rdo rje phag mo'i rigs zhal ma gnyis/ phag mo'i gnam zhabs ma/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba'i phag mo phyag bzhi ma/ phag mo kurma pa ti/ phag mo ljang gu dus 'khor lugs/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed rnams dang*/ thabs 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ gzhan yang mai tri mkha' spyod/ dbu bcad ma/ don grub ma/ go cha'i dpa' mo drug mkha' spyod dkar dmar la sogs pa rnam grangs shin tu mang ba bzhugs/ lha khang mdo na dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas 'byung ba ltar rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ rigs sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i rnam pa rnams bzhugs/ /bde ba can gyi lha khang na/ rten gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa sku tshad rgyab mtho bcu gcig pa/ rgyab yol dang bcas pa/ rgyu gser dngul zangs gsum las grub cing*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i 'phra rgyan can byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od dpag tu med pa 'di lags/ 'di nyid kyi sku'i g.yas dang g.yon du yang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa nyid kyi sku brnyan byin chags pa re re bzhugs/ rgya nag chen po la sogs pa'i yul rnams dang*/ bod yul 'dir yang sngon rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa'i skabs/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyis lha khang che thang du bzhengs pa mdzad 'dug na'ang*/ phyis de'i srol ka nub pa lta bur 'dug pas/ slar yang srol dar ba gzhan la mig ltos la yang phan pa srid dam gang ltar yang mthong thos dran reg rnams thar ba'i lam du 'dren pa la gzhan pas thugs rje che bar gsungs 'dug pas/ sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir bzhengs par gda'/ gyang ris la rgyal ba 'od snang nyid kyi sku brnyan mang po dang*/ rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sku brnyan stong phrag gsum bzhugs/ lha khang mdo ma na rgyud ris 'od dpag med kyi sku che ba mang po dang*/

bde ba can gyi zhing bkod dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi sngon thugs bskyed tshul gyi bkod pa dang*/ 'o skol gyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo gsungs pa'i bkod pa rnams bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang bde ba can gyi steng khang 'di na/ rten gyi gtso bo/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes le'u las gsal bar gsungs pa'i mchod rten la mtshan tu yang ye shes mchod rten du grags pa 'di yin te/ de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi rten yang yin/ yang sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs pa'i gnas chos kyi sku'i rten la/ mchod rten ces yongs su grags pa 'di la bzo bkod rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod kyang gzhan rnams la cha tshad nges can mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa med/ cha tshad kyi yi ge kha re yod pa rnams kyang*/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa'i skye bo 'ga' re'i thugs las spros pa tsam yin gsungs par 'dug ye shes mchod rten 'di la rgya dpangs kyi tshad nges can dang*/ phyi nang gzhan gsum dag sbyor rgyas pa dang bcas pa rgyud nyid las 'byung ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'grel pas rgyas par bkral ba lags/ rgyud gzhung las gsal bar gsungs pa'i tshad dang ldan cing*/ bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ byin chags pa 'di nyid gtso bor bzhugs nas/ 'khor gyi tshul du deng sang kun la grags pa bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad ces zer/ don la ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten bya ba/ de rnams kyis bkod pa gda'/ de yang sku'i g.yas kyi 'di ni bkra shis sgo mang chos 'khor mchod rten yin zhes sogs gral bstar bzhin rim gyis brjod/ g.yon gyi dang po 'di bdud bdul mchod rten ces kyang bya ba byang chub chen po mchod rten te zhes sogs/ de bzhin du 'jug chugs su ngo sprad/ de ltar na mchod rten ngo mtshar can/

gtso 'khor dgu po 'di rnams gser dngul sogs rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ bzo bkod legs shing tshad dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ g.yu byur mu tig shel sog 'phra rgyan phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'di kun bsdoms kyi dbang du byas na 'phra'i rnam grangs khri khrag rgal nges pa yod/ nang bzhugs su thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 'khrul med mang nyung ji ltar 'os pa re res gtso byas/ byin rlabs rten bzang la mang ba dang*/ gzungs kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ 'di'i gyang ris la/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas lo tsā ba rnam gnyis/ 'phags pa thogs med/ dus zhabs pa chen po rnams dang*/ gzhan yang mtshan byang bzhin du/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyi sku brnyan bzhugs/ /pad+ma bkod kyi lha khang phug na/ rten gyi gtso bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge drug pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs su slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po ste/ 'bur dod kyi sku gzugs gsum dang*/ logs bris la 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal/ rta mgrin/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa la sogs pa bzhugs/ lha khang mdo na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khor mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ de nyid kyi rnam thar zhing bkod/ lo rgyus tshad ldan kho na dang bstun pas yid ches pa'i gnas dang*/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas jo nang ba chen po slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ de nyid kyi rnam thar zhing bkod ngo mtshar che ba rags rims rnams bzhugs/ /lcang lo can gsang bdag gi lha khang 'di na/ rten gyi gtso bo phyag rdor mdo lugs/ byin rlabs kyi stobs las/ sa bdag klu gnyan sogs sde brgyad bran du 'khol bar mdzad pa 'di dang*/ gyang ris la gsang bdag zhi ba rdor sems/ gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ gsang bdag gtum po/

'byung po 'du byed/ rdo rje rnam 'joms rnams dang*/ star gsum la phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya dang*/ gtum po dmar po dang*/ rnam thos sras kyi rigs sna tshogs pa bzhugs/ /bde 'byung sham bha la'i lha khang 'di la/ gtsang khang na rten gtso rdo rje 'chang chen po khri rgyab dang bcas pa/ rgyu gser zangs las grub cing byon legs pa/ mtha' skor du chos rgyal bdun rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga/ 'khor lo can drag po dang bcas pa rnams 'bur skur bzhugs shing*/ rgyud ris la byang phyogs dpal ldan sham+bha la'i bkod pa/ bod yul gyi dpal ldan sham+bha la ri khrod jo nang gi bkod pa/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi yum byang chub sems ma dang khro mo'i tshogs rnams bzhugs/ lha khang mdo ma na/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rtsa rgyud gsungs pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan skyes dang*/ chos rgyal rigs ldan gyi tshogs rnams rgyud ris su bzhugs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i lha khang bstan bsrung mgon po'i gnas mchog 'di na/ phug gi mgon khang dngos na/ dbus kyi gtso bor rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po g.yas g.yon mtha' skor du/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ lha mo 'dod khams ma/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ stobs 'phrog nag po bram gzugs rnams bzhugs/ mgon khang mdo ma na logs bris kyi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ las kyi mgon po ber nag zangs gri can/ lha mo dmag zor ma/ dur khrod bdag po/ gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu dra lcam dral la sogs pa/ las gshin dmar nag chos bdag sman btsun ma/ las mkhan gdung dmar can la sogs pa bzhugs/ /gnod sbyin nor lha'i lha khang 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ rten gyi gtso bo byang chub sems dpa' gnod gnas dbang po zhes kyang bya/ 'phags pa chu dbang snying rje chen po zhes kyang bya/ gnod sbyin gser gyi mdog can dzam bha la zhes kyang bya ba/ mdor na mdo sngags thams cad las gsungs shing*/

nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i nor lha thams cad kyi gtso bo 'phags pa dzam bha lha'i sku brnyan 'di/ bzo khyad legs shing rgyan gyi bkod pa la sogs pa ches phun sum tshogs pa/ 'di bzhengs tsam nyid nas gnas 'dir 'byon pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel ba sogs shin tu bkra shis pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba lags/ 'di ni 'phags ma nor rgyun ma phyag drug ma sa bzang paṇa chen gyi thugs dam/ 'di ni tshogs bdag dkar po/ 'di ni dzam bha la nag po ste/ 'di nyid kyang rje btsun nyid kyis gsar bzhengs su gnang ba byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan can yin/ gyang ris la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las byung ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag dang mthun pa/ dzam bha la zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dzam ser phyag gnyis pa/ dzam bha la nag po'am khro bo 'chol ba'i dzam bha la/ rnam sras ljang khu be con ma/ dzam bha la dkar po 'brug zhon ma/ 'jur gegs sel ba'i tshogs bdag /nor rgyun ma ba lang rdzi rnams bzhugs/ g.yon gyi phyogs la gnod sbyin a pa ra tsi ta/ nor rgyun ma phyag gnyis ma/ dzam bha la la dmar po grwa pa mngon shes lugs dang*/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje btsun nyid/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga/ dus kyi 'khor lo las byung ba'i dzam bha la ljang khu/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ yang nor rgyun ma/ khol po kun da li rnams bzhugs/ de ltar mthil gyi gtsug lag khang 'di rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ phyi sgo chen po re re'i nang du chud pa rnams gcig tu rtsis pa'i dbang du byas na/ dbus su gtsug lag khang chen po mtha' gtsug lag khang bcu drug ste/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i lha khang bcu bdun yin/ de dag re re'i nang sel rnam grangs kyis phye na/ lha khang gi grangs lnga bcu tsam yod/ gzhan yang gsung spar mang po bzhugs pa'i spar khang dang*/ ri bo'i ngos dang rtse mo'i phyogs la 'jam dpal khro rgyal lha khang dang*/

mgon khang u tsa la dang*/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang*/ gzims khang po ṭa la dang*/ sau raṣ+ta dang*/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa gtsug lag khang gi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa bzhugs te/ bskal pa'i mtha'i bar du 'gro don 'phrin las nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing chu bo'i rgyun ltar chad pa med la/ ri rab ltar brtan cing*/ nyi 'od ltar gzi brjid kyi dpal 'bar bar bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar dkon mchog bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phel ba dang*/ nges don bstan pa'i bdag po jo nang ba'i/ /'phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ chos grwa bye ba grangs med kyi dbus na/ ri rab ltar mngon par mtho ba rtag brtan dam chos gling 'di nyid kyi gnas kyi rtse mor gyur pa gzims khang po ṭa la 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ lha khang phug ma na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kha sar pa ṇa/ g.yas su sgrol ma dang nor bzang*/ g.yon du khro gnyer can dang rta mgrin te/ 'phags pa lha lnga'i 'bur sku shin tu mtshar ba byin rlabs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bzhugs/ bar gyi lha khang ka gnyis ma 'di na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug ma rigs gsum/ seng ge sgra/ ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa/ 'phags pa pad+ma dkar dbang*/ spyan ras gzigs drag po chen po/ khams gsum dbang sdud kyi spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa dang gnyis pa/ yid bzhin nor bu'i 'khor los bsgyur ba phyag bzhi pa dang*/ phyag gnyis pa*/ rgyal ba rgya mtshor grags pa yig drug dmar po/ don zhags phyag bcu pa/ don yod lcags kyu/ don yod mchod pa'i nor bu/ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma drwa ba/ 'jig rten mgon po/ rje btsun ri khrod pa/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa rnams logs bris su bzhugs/ phyi'i bar 'khyams la/ g.yas phyogs su lho phyogs ri po ṭa la'i bkod pa/ g.yon phyogs na dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha ri bo po ta la byon pa'i bkod pa rnams bzhugs/
